title: Batch 156 — eight additional in-place Hebrew Sicha/Maamar enrichments; Yiddish Yechidus page exposes audio metadata only
review_method: Manual public web/open inspection of eight existing Hebrew publisher source bodies. Each cited body range was opened directly; search snippets and titles were not used as content. One Yiddish Yechidus page (AID 553691) exposed only title/audio-archive navigation and no transcript, so it was blocked as a content source. No crawler retry or access-control bypass; the eight readable Hebrew bodies were used as same-run fallback.

blocked_candidates.status: Public page exposes title and audio-archive links only; no transcript/body text
blocked_candidates.reason: The Yiddish Yechidus page is a media/archive listing and does not expose an inspectable transcript.
blocked_candidates.handling: No proposition added. No crawler retry or access-control bypass. Eight readable Hebrew source bodies were inspected as same-run fallback.

metadata_only_candidates.reason: Audio archive listing only; no transcript body.

excluded_candidates.reason: No inspectable Yiddish transcript; excluded from content propositions.

metrics_note: The preceding PR-head reconciliation run 44247225683 measured 1519/854/3895 in its CI workspace after batch155, then failed at a stale AID 2988877 proposition-count assertion. That snapshot is uncommitted and is not the public main metric. Batch156 adds eight in-place propositions; its planning boundary is 1519/854/3903 pending a clean full reconciliation and readiness run. Public metrics are not edited manually.

deduplication_check.note: All eight AIDs were found as one existing canonical record in their stated canonical item file; each existing Evidence Family ID and source URL was preserved. The current public search index is too large for the connector, so global AID/URL/ID/Evidence Family collision and answer-eligibility checks remain pending full canonical reconciliation.
